newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products pulled higher by futures gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products pulled higher by futures gains.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Wednesday, traders said.
Cracked fuel oil prices were firmer. High sulphur barges continued to get support from cargo pricing in early trade but this support faded later on and prices drifted off early highs.
Heating oil barge premiums slipped 50 cents or so to try and balance out a $3.25 gain on futures. Cargo premiums were firmer in the case of FOD and Russian material, but easier for DIN.
Gasoline was firm on the crude gains and healthy demand. Winter spec Eurograde barges were done at $214 fob ARA and offered at $215.
